summary: This study tests giving the drug semaglutide before and after a second weight loss surgery for people who gained weight back after their first surgery. The trial aims to enroll 100 participants to see how well different treatments help with weight loss. It is a Phase 4 study sponsored by the General Committee of Teaching Hospitals and Institutes, Egypt. Currently, the trial status is Not yet recruiting.
